name: octoprint
title: OctoPrint
description: OctoPrint controls a 3D printer over USB from a web page: upload G-code, start and watch prints, see temperatures, add plugins. The printer must be connected to this host and its serial path must exist, or the container does not start (usually /dev/ttyACM0 or /dev/ttyUSB0; ls /dev/serial/by-id/ gives a path that survives reboots). After deploying, follow the setup wizard and pick /dev/ttyACM0 as the serial port.
auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)

variables.name: PORT_OCTOPRINT
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page

variables.name: OCTOPRINT_DEVICE
variables.label: Printer device
variables.description: Host path of the printer's serial port; a /dev/serial/by-id/... path survives reboots. It appears in the container as /dev/ttyACM0
